entities.summary: Jacinto Agcaoili Jose is a Filipino bishop of the Roman Catholic Church who has been serving as the Bishop of the Diocese of Urdaneta since 2005. Before his episcopal appointment, he was the Diocesan Administrator of the Laoag.
